parts.text:
The metre rule is clamped in position near to the spring. Do not change the position of the
metre rule.

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Use the set square provided to take readings from the metre rule to determine the
unstretched length L of the coiled part of the spring. Record the value of L.
L =  ...................................................mm [1]
